query: Current NIFC IMSR active large fire count for mid-July 2026 (July 11-15), trajectory of national large fire counts and National Preparedness Level
answer:
The `StructuredOutput` tool call has been submitted successfully, completing the research task.

**Summary of findings for the NIFC IMSR mid-July 2026 research question:**

- **National Preparedness Level:** PL 4 (of 5), steady throughout July 11–16, 2026; reached ~June 29, 2026
- **Uncontained large fire trajectory:** 42 → 44 → 46 → 46 → 48 → 49 (rising, +7 over six days)
- **Current status (July 16):** 49 uncontained large fires, 76 active incidents
- **YTD:** 39,764 fires / 3,674,911 acres (~129%/131% of 10-year average)
- **Regional drivers:** Great Basin (GBCC) and Rocky Mountain (RMCC) GACCs
- **Notable event:** Gold Mountain Fire helicopter pilot fatality (July 12)

The deliverable included 10 key facts, 18 data points (each sourced with metric/value/unit/as_of/source_url), and 9 sources — all drawn from official NICC/NIFC IMSR reports and cross-validated. The task is complete.

key_facts: National Preparedness Level was PL 4 (of 5) throughout July 11-16, 2026, reached on approximately June 29, 2026.
Uncontained large fires rose from 42 (July 11) to 49 (July 16), a net increase of 7 over six days.
As of the July 16, 2026 IMSR, there were 49 uncontained large fires and 76 active incidents nationally.
Year-to-date through July 16, 2026: 39,764 fires and 3,674,911 acres burned.
YTD fire count was ~129% and acreage ~131% of the 10-year average.
New large fire ignitions ranged from 4 to 12 per day across the window (peak of 12 on July 12).
Two GACCs drove national resource demand at elevated preparedness: Great Basin (GBCC) and Rocky Mountain (RMCC).
A firefighting helicopter pilot fatality occurred on the Gold Mountain Fire on July 12, 2026.
Over 17,500 personnel were committed to wildland fire operations nationally as of mid-July 2026.
IMSR archive URL pattern enabled full daily trajectory retrieval: IMSR_CY26_MMDDYYYY.pdf under the NICC 2026/July directory.
